# Overview

This R Markdown file provides the code used to identify ASVs showing
stage-associated enrichment or depletion between pre-fermentation grains
(BZ) and pre-fermentation grains (EZ).

## Analysis principles

1. Raw integer ASV counts are used as the input for ANCOM-BC2.
2. Relative abundance is calculated using the library size after basic QC and
   before prevalence filtering, so the denominator remains fixed downstream.
3. ASVs are retained when prevalence is at least 10% in at least one
   Stage × Season group, forming one common BZ–EZ union feature space.
4. Complete matched BZ–EZ production contexts are selected only after the union
   feature space has been fixed.
5. The global stage effect is tested once using ANCOM-BC2 with
   `fix_formula = "BrewingGroupID + Stage"`, where
   `BrewingGroupID = BrewingCycle × Season × Park`.
6. Descriptive aggregation follows:
   biological replicates → Cycle context → Park × Season → Season/Park → Overall.
7. The descriptive aggregation statistic is the median throughout.

## Main outputs

The workflow writes QC files, the Stage × Season prevalence-filter table,
matched-context summaries, the single global ANCOM-BC2 result, median-based
recurrence diagnostics, DeltaCLR heterogeneity diagnostics, the final
one-row-per-ASV evidence table, and stage-specific core-ASV summaries.

The output directory also contains a parameter manifest and `sessionInfo()` to
support reproducibility.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
)
```

## 0. Parameters

```{r parameters}
## Change these four lines when switching Bacteria / Fungi.
DATASET_LABEL <- "Bacteria"
OTU_FILE  <- "ASV_table_delete.tsv"
META_FILE <- "sample_metadata.xlsx"
TAX_FILE  <- "Taxonomy.tsv"   # set to "" if unavailable

OTU_SHEET  <- NULL
META_SHEET <- NULL
TAX_SHEET  <- NULL

OUT_DIR <- paste0(DATASET_LABEL, "BZ_EZ_stage_selection")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

SAMPLE_ID_COL <- "SampleID"
TYPE_COL      <- "SampleType"
YEAR_COL      <- "Year"
SEASON_COL    <- "Season"
PARK_COL      <- "Park"
REP_COL       <- "Replicate"
CYCLE_COL     <- "BrewingCycle"

AUTO_DERIVE_CYCLE_IF_MISSING <- TRUE
STRICT_CYCLE_CHECK <- TRUE

CORE_CYCLES    <- c("Cycle1", "Cycle2")
SEASON_LEVELS  <- c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")
EXPECTED_PARKS <- c("70", "30", "5")
ANALYSIS_TYPES <- c("BZ", "EZ")
EXPECTED_N_BIOREP <- 3

## Keep an ASV if prevalence >=10% in at least one Stage × Season group.
PREVALENCE_CUT_PRIMARY <- 0.10

## Descriptive thresholds.
HIGH_ABUND    <- 0.001       # 0.1%
MIN_REP_PREV  <- 2/3         # detected in >=2 of 3 biological replicates
MIN_UNIT_PREV <- 2/3         # descriptive prevalence requirement

RESPONSE_FOLD_CUTOFF <- 2
LFC_RESPONSE <- log2(RESPONSE_FOLD_CUTOFF)

## Persistent_candidate is auxiliary and is deliberately more conservative
## than the 2-fold response cutoff, avoiding overlap in interpretation.
PERSISTENT_MAX_FOLD_CHANGE <- 1.25
LFC_PERSISTENT_MAX <- log2(PERSISTENT_MAX_FOLD_CHANGE)

## One descriptive pseudo-count only. It is used only to make log2(EZ/BZ)
## finite when a descriptive abundance equals zero. It is NOT a robustness
## criterion and has no role in ANCOM-BC2 significance.
RATIO_PSEUDOCOUNT_MULTIPLIER <- 0.5
CLR_PSEUDOCOUNT_COUNT <- 0.5

FDR_CUTOFF <- 0.05

RUN_ANCOMBC2 <- TRUE
ANCOM_P_ADJ_METHOD <- "BH"
ANCOM_PSEUDO_SENS  <- TRUE
ANCOM_PRV_CUT <- 0
ANCOM_NEG_LB <- FALSE
ANCOM_N_CL <- 1

SUMMARY_METHOD <- "median"
```

## 2. Utility functions

```{r utility-functions}
read_auto <- function(path, sheet = NULL) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("File not found: ", path)
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(path))

  if (ext == "csv") {
    return(readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "minimal"))
  }
  if (ext %in% c("tsv", "txt")) {
    return(readr::read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "minimal"))
  }
  if (ext %in% c("xlsx", "xls")) {
    if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Excel input requires package 'readxl'.")
    if (is.null(sheet)) sheet <- 1
    return(readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, .name_repair = "minimal") %>%
             as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE) %>% tibble::as_tibble())
  }
  stop("Unsupported file type: ", ext)
}

as_numeric_matrix_strict <- function(x, object_name = "OTU table") {
  raw <- as.matrix(x)
  suppressWarnings(num <- matrix(as.numeric(raw), nrow = nrow(raw), ncol = ncol(raw),
                                 dimnames = dimnames(raw)))
  raw_chr <- trimws(as.character(raw))
  bad <- is.na(as.vector(num)) & !is.na(as.vector(raw)) & nzchar(raw_chr) &
    !toupper(raw_chr) %in% c("NA", "NAN")
  if (any(bad)) {
    stop(object_name, " contains non-numeric values, e.g. ",
         paste(head(unique(raw_chr[bad]), 10), collapse = ", "))
  }
  num
}

normalize_season <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))

  key <- tolower(x)
  map <- c(
    "spring" = "Spring",
    "summer" = "Summer",
    "autumn" = "Autumn",
    "fall" = "Autumn",
    "winter" = "Winter"
  )

  hit <- key %in% names(map)
  x[hit] <- unname(map[key[hit]])
  x
}

derive_brewing_cycle <- function(year, season) {
  y <- as.character(year)
  s <- normalize_season(season)
  dplyr::case_when(
    y == "2023" & s == "Spring" ~ "Boundary_Pre",
    y == "2023" & s %in% c("Summer", "Autumn", "Winter") ~ "Cycle1",
    y == "2024" & s == "Spring" ~ "Cycle1",
    y == "2024" & s %in% c("Summer", "Autumn", "Winter") ~ "Cycle2",
    y == "2025" & s == "Spring" ~ "Cycle2",
    y == "2025" & s == "Summer" ~ "Boundary_Post",
    TRUE ~ "Unassigned"
  )
}

summary_value <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  stats::median(x)
}

safe_ratio <- function(num, den, pc) {
  log2((num + pc) / (den + pc))
}

sign_class <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    x > 0 ~ "Up",
    x < 0 ~ "Down",
    TRUE ~ "Zero"
  )
}

strong_response_class <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    x >= LFC_RESPONSE ~ "Up_2fold_or_more",
    x <= -LFC_RESPONSE ~ "Down_2fold_or_more",
    TRUE ~ "Below_2fold"
  )
}

factor_block_p_available <- function(dat, response, target_factor, covariates = character(0)) {
  vars_needed <- unique(c(response, target_factor, covariates))
  vars_needed <- vars_needed[vars_needed %in% names(dat)]
  dat <- dat[complete.cases(dat[, vars_needed, drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(dat) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  if (length(unique(dat[[target_factor]])) < 2) return(NA_real_)

  cov_keep <- covariates[vapply(covariates, function(v) {
    v %in% names(dat) && length(unique(na.omit(dat[[v]]))) > 1
  }, logical(1))]

  reduced_rhs <- if (length(cov_keep) == 0) "1" else paste(cov_keep, collapse = " + ")
  full_rhs <- paste(unique(c(target_factor, cov_keep)), collapse = " + ")
  f0 <- as.formula(paste(response, "~", reduced_rhs))
  f1 <- as.formula(paste(response, "~", full_rhs))

  tryCatch({
    m0 <- lm(f0, data = dat)
    m1 <- lm(f1, data = dat)
    if (df.residual(m1) <= 0) return(NA_real_)
    a <- anova(m0, m1)
    p <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(a$`Pr(>F)`[2]))
    if (!is.finite(p)) NA_real_ else p
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

stage_season_prevalence <- function(count_mat, meta_df, stage_name, season_name,
                                    prevalence_cut = PREVALENCE_CUT_PRIMARY) {
  sample_ids <- meta_df %>%
    filter(as.character(Stage) == stage_name,
           as.character(Season) == season_name) %>%
    pull(SampleID) %>% as.character()
  sample_ids <- intersect(sample_ids, colnames(count_mat))

  if (length(sample_ids) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      Stage = stage_name,
      Season = season_name,
      TaxonID = rownames(count_mat),
      NSamplesStageSeason = 0L,
      DetectedN = 0L,
      Prevalence = NA_real_,
      RequiredDetectedN = NA_integer_,
      KeepStageSeason = FALSE
    ))
  }

  detected_n <- rowSums(count_mat[, sample_ids, drop = FALSE] > 0)
  prevalence <- detected_n / length(sample_ids)

  tibble(
    Stage = stage_name,
    Season = season_name,
    TaxonID = rownames(count_mat),
    NSamplesStageSeason = length(sample_ids),
    DetectedN = as.integer(detected_n),
    Prevalence = as.numeric(prevalence),
    RequiredDetectedN = ceiling(prevalence_cut * length(sample_ids)),
    KeepStageSeason = prevalence >= prevalence_cut
  )
}

build_context_clr <- function(count_mat, meta_df, taxa_ids, sample_ids) {
  taxa_ids <- intersect(taxa_ids, rownames(count_mat))
  sample_ids <- intersect(sample_ids, colnames(count_mat))
  if (length(taxa_ids) < 2) stop("CLR requires at least two taxa.")

  cm <- count_mat[taxa_ids, sample_ids, drop = FALSE]
  if (any(colSums(cm) <= 0)) stop("Zero-total sample in CLR matrix.")

  clr_mat <- apply(cm, 2, function(x) {
    lx <- log(x + CLR_PSEUDOCOUNT_COUNT)
    lx - mean(lx)
  })
  if (is.vector(clr_mat)) {
    clr_mat <- matrix(clr_mat, nrow = nrow(cm), ncol = ncol(cm), dimnames = dimnames(cm))
  }
  rownames(clr_mat) <- rownames(cm)
  colnames(clr_mat) <- colnames(cm)

  as.data.frame(t(clr_mat), check.names = FALSE) %>%
    rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>% as_tibble() %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -SampleID, names_to = "TaxonID", values_to = "CLR") %>%
    left_join(meta_df, by = "SampleID") %>%
    group_by(BrewingCycle, Season, Park, BrewingGroupID, Stage, TaxonID) %>%
    summarise(
      CLR = summary_value(CLR),
      NBioRep = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```

## 3. Metadata: BZ and EZ only

```{r metadata}
meta_raw <- read_auto(META_FILE, META_SHEET)
required_cols <- c(SAMPLE_ID_COL, TYPE_COL, YEAR_COL, SEASON_COL, PARK_COL, REP_COL)
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(meta_raw))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Metadata is missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

meta_work <- meta_raw %>%
  mutate(
    .SampleID = trimws(as.character(.data[[SAMPLE_ID_COL]])),
    .Stage = toupper(trimws(as.character(.data[[TYPE_COL]]))),
    .Year = as.character(.data[[YEAR_COL]]),
    .Season = normalize_season(.data[[SEASON_COL]]),
    .Park = trimws(as.character(.data[[PARK_COL]])),
    .Replicate = as.character(.data[[REP_COL]])
  )
meta_work$.ExpectedCycle <- derive_brewing_cycle(meta_work$.Year, meta_work$.Season)

if (!CYCLE_COL %in% names(meta_work)) {
  if (!AUTO_DERIVE_CYCLE_IF_MISSING) stop("BrewingCycle is absent and automatic derivation is disabled.")
  meta_work[[CYCLE_COL]] <- meta_work$.ExpectedCycle
}
meta_work$.BrewingCycle <- as.character(meta_work[[CYCLE_COL]])

cycle_mismatch <- meta_work %>%
  transmute(
    SampleID = .SampleID,
    BrewingCycle_metadata = .BrewingCycle,
    BrewingCycle_expected = .ExpectedCycle,
    Match = BrewingCycle_metadata == BrewingCycle_expected
  ) %>%
  filter(BrewingCycle_expected != "Unassigned", is.na(Match) | !Match)

if (nrow(cycle_mismatch) > 0 && STRICT_CYCLE_CHECK) {
  write.csv(cycle_mismatch,
            file.path(OUT_DIR, "ERROR_BrewingCycle_mapping_mismatch.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  stop("BrewingCycle mapping mismatch detected.")
}

meta <- meta_work %>%
  transmute(
    SampleID = .SampleID,
    Stage = .Stage,
    Year = .Year,
    Season = .Season,
    Park = .Park,
    Replicate = .Replicate,
    BrewingCycle = .BrewingCycle
  ) %>%
  filter(BrewingCycle %in% CORE_CYCLES, Stage %in% ANALYSIS_TYPES)

if (nrow(meta) == 0) stop("No BZ/EZ samples remain in Cycle1/Cycle2.")
if (anyNA(meta) || any(!nzchar(meta$SampleID)) || any(!nzchar(meta$Replicate))) {
  stop("Analysis metadata contains missing design fields or blank sample/replicate identifiers.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(meta$SampleID)) stop("Duplicated SampleID values found in metadata.")

bad_seasons <- setdiff(unique(meta$Season), SEASON_LEVELS)
if (length(bad_seasons) > 0) {
  stop("Unrecognized Season values: ", paste(bad_seasons, collapse = ", "))
}

observed_parks <- sort(unique(meta$Park))
if (!setequal(observed_parks, sort(EXPECTED_PARKS))) {
  stop("Observed parks do not match EXPECTED_PARKS. Observed: ",
       paste(observed_parks, collapse = "; "), "; expected: ",
       paste(EXPECTED_PARKS, collapse = "; "))
}

meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    BrewingCycle = factor(BrewingCycle, levels = CORE_CYCLES),
    Season = factor(Season, levels = SEASON_LEVELS),
    Park = factor(Park, levels = EXPECTED_PARKS),
    Stage = factor(Stage, levels = ANALYSIS_TYPES),
    BrewingGroupID = paste(as.character(BrewingCycle), as.character(Season),
                            as.character(Park), sep = "_")
  )
```

## 4. OTU/ASV table + basic QC

```{r asv-table-qc}
otu_raw <- read_auto(OTU_FILE, OTU_SHEET)
first_col_values <- as.character(otu_raw[[1]])
overlap_cols <- sum(meta$SampleID %in% names(otu_raw))
overlap_rows <- sum(meta$SampleID %in% first_col_values)
if (overlap_cols == 0 && overlap_rows == 0) stop("No SampleID overlap between OTU table and metadata.")

if (overlap_cols >= overlap_rows) {
  taxa_id <- as.character(otu_raw[[1]])
  otu_mat <- as_numeric_matrix_strict(otu_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE], "Taxa × Samples OTU table")
  rownames(otu_mat) <- taxa_id
} else {
  sample_id <- as.character(otu_raw[[1]])
  x <- as_numeric_matrix_strict(otu_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE], "Samples × Taxa OTU table")
  rownames(x) <- sample_id
  otu_mat <- t(x)
}

if (anyDuplicated(rownames(otu_mat))) stop("Duplicated TaxonID values found.")
if (anyDuplicated(colnames(otu_mat))) stop("Duplicated SampleID columns found in OTU table.")
if (any(!is.finite(otu_mat))) stop("OTU table contains NA/NaN/Inf.")
if (any(otu_mat < 0)) stop("OTU table contains negative values.")
if (any(abs(otu_mat - round(otu_mat)) > 1e-8)) stop("OTU table must contain raw integer counts.")

common_samples <- intersect(meta$SampleID, colnames(otu_mat))
if (length(common_samples) == 0) stop("No samples remain after OTU-metadata matching.")

meta <- meta %>%
  filter(SampleID %in% common_samples) %>%
  arrange(BrewingCycle, Season, Park, Stage, Replicate)
otu_mat <- otu_mat[, meta$SampleID, drop = FALSE]

zero_samples <- colnames(otu_mat)[colSums(otu_mat) <= 0]
if (length(zero_samples) > 0) {
  keep_samples <- setdiff(colnames(otu_mat), zero_samples)
  otu_mat <- otu_mat[, keep_samples, drop = FALSE]
  meta <- meta %>% filter(SampleID %in% keep_samples)
}
otu_mat <- otu_mat[rowSums(otu_mat) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(otu_mat) < 2L || ncol(otu_mat) == 0L) {
  stop("Insufficient taxa or samples remain after basic QC.")
}
```

## 5. Freeze relative-abundance denominator BEFORE prevalence filtering

```{r freeze-ra-denominator}
base_library_size <- colSums(otu_mat)
if (any(base_library_size <= 0)) stop("Zero-library sample remains after basic QC.")

otu_rel_all <- sweep(otu_mat, 2, base_library_size, "/")
if (any(abs(colSums(otu_rel_all) - 1) > 1e-8)) {
  stop("Relative-abundance calculation failed: sample sums are not 1.")
}

write.csv(
  data.frame(TaxonID = rownames(otu_rel_all), otu_rel_all, check.names = FALSE),
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "00_BZ_EZ_relative_abundance_before_prevalence_filter.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

min_nonzero_relative_abundance <- min(otu_rel_all[otu_rel_all > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
RATIO_PSEUDOCOUNT <- RATIO_PSEUDOCOUNT_MULTIPLIER * min_nonzero_relative_abundance
```

## 6. Stage × Season prevalence filtering FIRST

```{r prevalence-filter}
stage_prev_long <- bind_rows(lapply(ANALYSIS_TYPES, function(st) {
  bind_rows(lapply(SEASON_LEVELS, function(se) {
    stage_season_prevalence(otu_mat, meta, st, se, PREVALENCE_CUT_PRIMARY)
  }))
})) %>%
  mutate(
    StageSeason = paste(Stage, Season, sep = "_"),
    StageSeason = factor(
      StageSeason,
      levels = as.vector(outer(ANALYSIS_TYPES, SEASON_LEVELS, paste, sep = "_"))
    )
  )

retained_summary <- stage_prev_long %>%
  group_by(TaxonID) %>%
  summarise(
    NStageSeasonGroupsObserved = sum(NSamplesStageSeason > 0),
    NStageSeasonGroupsPassing = sum(KeepStageSeason, na.rm = TRUE),
    MaxStageSeasonPrevalence = if (all(is.na(Prevalence))) NA_real_ else max(Prevalence, na.rm = TRUE),
    RetainedByStageSeasonUnion = any(KeepStageSeason %in% TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stage_prev_wide <- stage_prev_long %>%
  mutate(StageSeason = as.character(StageSeason)) %>%
  select(TaxonID, StageSeason, NSamplesStageSeason, DetectedN,
         Prevalence, RequiredDetectedN, KeepStageSeason) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = StageSeason,
    values_from = c(NSamplesStageSeason, DetectedN, Prevalence,
                    RequiredDetectedN, KeepStageSeason),
    names_glue = "{StageSeason}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  left_join(retained_summary, by = "TaxonID")

write.csv(stage_prev_wide,
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "01_BZ_EZ_StageSeason_prevalence_filter.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

BZ_EZ_TAXA <- retained_summary %>%
  filter(RetainedByStageSeasonUnion) %>%
  pull(TaxonID) %>%
  intersect(rownames(otu_mat))

if (length(BZ_EZ_TAXA) == 0) stop("No taxa remain after Stage × Season prevalence union filtering.")
```

## 7. Comparison-specific complete matched BZ–EZ Cycle contexts

```{r matched-contexts}
context_coverage <- meta %>%
  mutate(Stage = factor(as.character(Stage), levels = ANALYSIS_TYPES)) %>%
  count(BrewingCycle, Season, Park, Stage, name = "NBioRep") %>%
  tidyr::complete(BrewingCycle, Season, Park, Stage, fill = list(NBioRep = 0)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Stage, values_from = NBioRep, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    BZ_EZ_Eligible = BZ == EXPECTED_N_BIOREP & EZ == EXPECTED_N_BIOREP,
    BrewingGroupID = paste(as.character(BrewingCycle), as.character(Season),
                            as.character(Park), sep = "_")
  )

write.csv(context_coverage,
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "00_QC_BZ_EZ_Cycle_context_coverage.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

eligible_groups <- context_coverage %>%
  filter(BZ_EZ_Eligible) %>%
  pull(BrewingGroupID) %>% as.character()

if (length(eligible_groups) < 2) stop("Too few complete matched BZ–EZ Cycle contexts.")

analysis_meta <- meta %>%
  filter(BrewingGroupID %in% eligible_groups) %>%
  mutate(
    Stage = factor(as.character(Stage), levels = ANALYSIS_TYPES),
    BrewingCycle = factor(as.character(BrewingCycle), levels = CORE_CYCLES),
    Season = factor(as.character(Season), levels = SEASON_LEVELS),
    Park = factor(as.character(Park), levels = EXPECTED_PARKS),
    BrewingGroupID = factor(BrewingGroupID)
  )

## Park × Season coverage after allowing one or two eligible cycles per cell.
park_season_coverage <- context_coverage %>%
  filter(BZ_EZ_Eligible) %>%
  group_by(Season, Park) %>%
  summarise(
    NEligibleCycles = n_distinct(BrewingCycle),
    EligibleCycles = paste(sort(unique(as.character(BrewingCycle))), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Season = factor(SEASON_LEVELS, levels = SEASON_LEVELS),
    Park = factor(EXPECTED_PARKS, levels = EXPECTED_PARKS),
    fill = list(NEligibleCycles = 0L, EligibleCycles = "")
  ) %>%
  mutate(ParkSeasonObserved = NEligibleCycles >= 1)

write.csv(park_season_coverage,
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "00_QC_BZ_EZ_ParkSeason_coverage.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

## 8. One global ANCOM-BC2 model at individual-sample level

```{r ancombc2}
run_global_ancombc2 <- function(count_mat, meta_df, taxa_keep) {
  if (!RUN_ANCOMBC2) {
    return(tibble(
      TaxonID = taxa_keep,
      ANCOM_LFC_ln = NA_real_, ANCOM_P = NA_real_, ANCOM_Q = NA_real_,
      ANCOM_Diff = NA, ANCOM_PassedSS = NA, ANCOM_DiffRobust = NA,
      ANCOM_StructuralZero = FALSE, ANCOM_StructuralDirection = NA_character_,
      ANCOMDirection = NA_character_, ANCOMStatLevel = "Not_tested",
      ANCOM_RobustSupported = FALSE, ANCOM_FDRNonrobust = FALSE
    ))
  }

  taxa_keep <- intersect(taxa_keep, rownames(count_mat))
  cm <- count_mat[taxa_keep, meta_df$SampleID, drop = FALSE]
  cm <- cm[rowSums(cm) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(cm) < 2L || any(colSums(cm) <= 0)) {
    stop("ANCOM-BC2 requires at least two retained taxa and nonzero sample libraries.")
  }

  md <- as.data.frame(meta_df)
  rownames(md) <- md$SampleID

  tse <- TreeSummarizedExperiment::TreeSummarizedExperiment(
    assays = S4Vectors::SimpleList(counts = cm),
    colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(md)
  )

  out <- ANCOMBC::ancombc2(
    data = tse,
    assay_name = "counts",
    tax_level = NULL,
    fix_formula = "BrewingGroupID + Stage",
    rand_formula = NULL,
    p_adj_method = ANCOM_P_ADJ_METHOD,
    pseudo_sens = ANCOM_PSEUDO_SENS,
    prv_cut = ANCOM_PRV_CUT,
    lib_cut = 0,
    s0_perc = 0.05,
    group = "Stage",
    struc_zero = TRUE,
    neg_lb = ANCOM_NEG_LB,
    alpha = FDR_CUTOFF,
    n_cl = ANCOM_N_CL,
    verbose = FALSE,
    global = FALSE,
    pairwise = FALSE,
    dunnet = FALSE,
    trend = FALSE,
    iter_control = list(tol = 1e-2, max_iter = 20, verbose = FALSE),
    em_control = list(tol = 1e-5, max_iter = 100)
  )

  raw_res <- as.data.frame(out$res, check.names = FALSE)
  lfc_cols <- grep("^lfc_Stage", names(raw_res), value = TRUE)
  if (length(lfc_cols) == 0) stop("Could not identify the ANCOM-BC2 Stage coefficient.")

  lfc_col <- lfc_cols[grepl("EZ", lfc_cols, fixed = TRUE)]
  if (length(lfc_col) == 0) lfc_col <- lfc_cols[1]
  lfc_col <- lfc_col[1]
  suffix <- sub("^lfc_", "", lfc_col)

  get_col <- function(prefix) {
    z <- paste0(prefix, "_", suffix)
    if (z %in% names(raw_res)) z else NA_character_
  }

  p_col <- get_col("p")
  q_col <- get_col("q")
  diff_col <- get_col("diff")
  ss_col <- get_col("passed_ss")
  robust_col <- get_col("diff_robust")

  taxon_values <- if ("taxon" %in% names(raw_res)) as.character(raw_res$taxon) else rownames(raw_res)

  primary <- tibble(
    TaxonID = taxon_values,
    ANCOM_LFC_ln = as.numeric(raw_res[[lfc_col]]),
    ANCOM_P = if (!is.na(p_col)) as.numeric(raw_res[[p_col]]) else NA_real_,
    ANCOM_Q = if (!is.na(q_col)) as.numeric(raw_res[[q_col]]) else NA_real_,
    ANCOM_Diff = if (!is.na(diff_col)) as.logical(raw_res[[diff_col]]) else NA,
    ANCOM_PassedSS = if (!is.na(ss_col)) as.logical(raw_res[[ss_col]]) else NA,
    ANCOM_DiffRobust = if (!is.na(robust_col)) {
      as.logical(raw_res[[robust_col]])
    } else if (!is.na(diff_col) && !is.na(ss_col)) {
      as.logical(raw_res[[diff_col]]) & as.logical(raw_res[[ss_col]])
    } else NA,
    ANCOM_StructuralZero = FALSE,
    ANCOM_StructuralDirection = NA_character_
  )

  ## Structural-zero taxa can be absent from out$res. Keep the full modeled
  ## taxon universe before merging their separate presence/absence evidence.
  primary <- tibble(TaxonID = rownames(cm)) %>%
    left_join(primary, by = "TaxonID") %>%
    mutate(ANCOM_StructuralZero = coalesce(ANCOM_StructuralZero, FALSE))

  if (!is.null(out$zero_ind)) {
    zr <- as.data.frame(out$zero_ind, check.names = FALSE)
    if (!("taxon" %in% names(zr))) zr <- tibble::rownames_to_column(zr, "taxon")

    pick_stage_col <- function(stage_name) {
      z_names <- setdiff(names(zr), "taxon")
      exact <- z_names[z_names == stage_name]
      if (length(exact) > 0) return(exact[1])
      hit <- z_names[grepl(stage_name, z_names, fixed = TRUE)]
      if (length(hit) == 1) return(hit[1])
      NA_character_
    }

    bz_col <- pick_stage_col("BZ")
    ez_col <- pick_stage_col("EZ")

    if (!is.na(bz_col) && !is.na(ez_col)) {
      zero_summary <- tibble(
        TaxonID = as.character(zr$taxon),
        BZ_StructuralZero = as.logical(zr[[bz_col]]),
        EZ_StructuralZero = as.logical(zr[[ez_col]])
      ) %>%
        filter(BZ_StructuralZero %in% TRUE | EZ_StructuralZero %in% TRUE) %>%
        transmute(
          TaxonID,
          ANCOM_StructuralZero_new = TRUE,
          ANCOM_StructuralDirection_new = case_when(
            BZ_StructuralZero %in% TRUE & !(EZ_StructuralZero %in% TRUE) ~
              "EZ_enriched_presence_absence",
            EZ_StructuralZero %in% TRUE & !(BZ_StructuralZero %in% TRUE) ~
              "EZ_depleted_presence_absence",
            TRUE ~ "Ambiguous_structural_zero"
          )
        )

      primary <- primary %>%
        left_join(zero_summary, by = "TaxonID") %>%
        mutate(
          ANCOM_StructuralZero = coalesce(ANCOM_StructuralZero_new, ANCOM_StructuralZero),
          ANCOM_StructuralDirection = coalesce(ANCOM_StructuralDirection_new,
                                               ANCOM_StructuralDirection)
        ) %>%
        select(-ANCOM_StructuralZero_new, -ANCOM_StructuralDirection_new)
    }
  }

  primary %>%
    mutate(
      ANCOMDirection = case_when(
        ANCOM_StructuralZero %in% TRUE &
          ANCOM_StructuralDirection == "EZ_enriched_presence_absence" ~ "Up",
        ANCOM_StructuralZero %in% TRUE &
          ANCOM_StructuralDirection == "EZ_depleted_presence_absence" ~ "Down",
        ANCOM_StructuralZero %in% TRUE ~ "Ambiguous",
        !is.na(ANCOM_LFC_ln) & ANCOM_LFC_ln > 0 ~ "Up",
        !is.na(ANCOM_LFC_ln) & ANCOM_LFC_ln < 0 ~ "Down",
        !is.na(ANCOM_LFC_ln) ~ "Zero",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      ANCOMStatLevel = case_when(
        ANCOM_StructuralZero %in% TRUE &
          ANCOM_StructuralDirection != "Ambiguous_structural_zero" ~
          "Structural_zero_supported",
        ANCOM_DiffRobust %in% TRUE ~ "ANCOMBC2_robust",
        ANCOM_Diff %in% TRUE ~ "ANCOMBC2_FDR_supported_nonrobust",
        TRUE ~ "Not_supported"
      ),
      ANCOM_RobustSupported =
        (ANCOM_StructuralZero %in% TRUE &
           ANCOM_StructuralDirection != "Ambiguous_structural_zero") |
        ANCOM_DiffRobust %in% TRUE,
      ANCOM_FDRNonrobust =
        !(ANCOM_RobustSupported %in% TRUE) & ANCOM_Diff %in% TRUE
    )
}

ancom_global <- tryCatch(
  run_global_ancombc2(otu_mat, analysis_meta, BZ_EZ_TAXA),
  error = function(e) stop("Global ANCOM-BC2 failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
)

write.csv(ancom_global,
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "03_ANCOMBC2_global_BZ_EZ_stage_effect.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

## 9. Relative-abundance data for matched comparison contexts

```{r relative-abundance-long}
rel_analysis <- otu_rel_all[BZ_EZ_TAXA, analysis_meta$SampleID, drop = FALSE]

rel_long_analysis <- as.data.frame(t(rel_analysis), check.names = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>% as_tibble() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -SampleID, names_to = "TaxonID", values_to = "RelAbund") %>%
  left_join(analysis_meta, by = "SampleID") %>%
  mutate(Present = RelAbund > 0)
```

## 10. Descriptive hierarchy: median only

```{r descriptive-median}
build_descriptive_pipeline <- function() {

  ## 10A. Biological replicates -> Cycle context
  context_stage <- rel_long_analysis %>%
    group_by(BrewingCycle, Season, Park, BrewingGroupID, Stage, TaxonID) %>%
    summarise(
      ContextAbundance = summary_value(RelAbund),
      ReplicatePrevalence = mean(Present, na.rm = TRUE),
      NBioRep = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  context_effects <- context_stage %>%
    mutate(Stage = as.character(Stage)) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(BrewingCycle, Season, Park, BrewingGroupID, TaxonID),
      names_from = Stage,
      values_from = c(ContextAbundance, ReplicatePrevalence, NBioRep),
      names_glue = "{.value}_{Stage}"
    ) %>%
    filter(NBioRep_BZ == EXPECTED_N_BIOREP,
           NBioRep_EZ == EXPECTED_N_BIOREP) %>%
    mutate(
      SummaryMethod = SUMMARY_METHOD,
      ContextLog2Ratio = safe_ratio(ContextAbundance_EZ,
                                    ContextAbundance_BZ,
                                    RATIO_PSEUDOCOUNT),
      ContextSign = sign_class(ContextLog2Ratio),
      ContextStrongClass = strong_response_class(ContextLog2Ratio),
      ContextPresent_BZ = ReplicatePrevalence_BZ >= MIN_REP_PREV,
      ContextPresent_EZ = ReplicatePrevalence_EZ >= MIN_REP_PREV
    )

  ## 10B. Cycle context -> Park × Season, using all AVAILABLE eligible cycles.
  park_season_effects <- context_effects %>%
    group_by(Season, Park, TaxonID) %>%
    summarise(
      ParkSeasonNContexts = n(),
      ParkSeasonNCycles = n_distinct(BrewingCycle),
      ParkSeasonCycles = paste(sort(unique(as.character(BrewingCycle))), collapse = ";"),
      ParkSeasonAbundance_BZ = summary_value(ContextAbundance_BZ),
      ParkSeasonAbundance_EZ = summary_value(ContextAbundance_EZ),
      ParkSeasonPresence_BZ = mean(ContextPresent_BZ, na.rm = TRUE),
      ParkSeasonPresence_EZ = mean(ContextPresent_EZ, na.rm = TRUE),
      ParkSeasonLog2Ratio = summary_value(ContextLog2Ratio),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      SummaryMethod = SUMMARY_METHOD,
      ParkSeasonSign = sign_class(ParkSeasonLog2Ratio),
      ParkSeasonStrongClass = strong_response_class(ParkSeasonLog2Ratio)
    )

  ## 10C. Park × Season -> Season (three parks are equal-weight units).
  season_effects <- park_season_effects %>%
    group_by(Season, TaxonID) %>%
    summarise(
      SeasonNParkSeasonCells = n(),
      SeasonNParks = n_distinct(Park),
      SeasonAbundance_BZ = summary_value(ParkSeasonAbundance_BZ),
      SeasonAbundance_EZ = summary_value(ParkSeasonAbundance_EZ),
      SeasonPresence_BZ = mean(ParkSeasonPresence_BZ >= MIN_UNIT_PREV, na.rm = TRUE),
      SeasonPresence_EZ = mean(ParkSeasonPresence_EZ >= MIN_UNIT_PREV, na.rm = TRUE),
      SeasonLog2Ratio = summary_value(ParkSeasonLog2Ratio),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      SummaryMethod = SUMMARY_METHOD,
      SeasonSign = sign_class(SeasonLog2Ratio),
      SeasonStrongClass = strong_response_class(SeasonLog2Ratio)
    )

  ## 10D. Park × Season -> Park (four seasons are equal-weight units).
  park_effects <- park_season_effects %>%
    group_by(Park, TaxonID) %>%
    summarise(
      ParkNParkSeasonCells = n(),
      ParkNSeasons = n_distinct(Season),
      ParkAbundance_BZ = summary_value(ParkSeasonAbundance_BZ),
      ParkAbundance_EZ = summary_value(ParkSeasonAbundance_EZ),
      ParkPresence_BZ = mean(ParkSeasonPresence_BZ >= MIN_UNIT_PREV, na.rm = TRUE),
      ParkPresence_EZ = mean(ParkSeasonPresence_EZ >= MIN_UNIT_PREV, na.rm = TRUE),
      ParkLog2Ratio = summary_value(ParkSeasonLog2Ratio),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      SummaryMethod = SUMMARY_METHOD,
      ParkSign = sign_class(ParkLog2Ratio),
      ParkStrongClass = strong_response_class(ParkLog2Ratio)
    )

  ## 10E. Season / Park -> Overall.
  ## Primary Overall is obtained from the four Season summaries so that the
  ## four seasons are equal-weight terminal units. A parallel Park-path
  ## Overall is also reported as a diagnostic check. Both paths have already
  ## passed through Cycle context -> Park × Season first.
  coverage_summary <- park_season_effects %>%
    group_by(TaxonID) %>%
    summarise(
      NParkSeasonAvailable = n(),
      NSeasonsAvailable = n_distinct(Season),
      NParksAvailable = n_distinct(Park),
      NParkSeasonCellsWithTwoCycles = sum(ParkSeasonNCycles >= 2),
      NParkSeasonCellsWithOneCycle = sum(ParkSeasonNCycles == 1),
      NParkSeasonUp = sum(ParkSeasonSign == "Up", na.rm = TRUE),
      NParkSeasonDown = sum(ParkSeasonSign == "Down", na.rm = TRUE),
      NParkSeasonZero = sum(ParkSeasonSign == "Zero", na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  overall_by_season <- season_effects %>%
    group_by(TaxonID) %>%
    summarise(
      OverallAbundance_BZ = summary_value(SeasonAbundance_BZ),
      OverallAbundance_EZ = summary_value(SeasonAbundance_EZ),
      BZ_SeasonPrevalence = mean(SeasonPresence_BZ >= MIN_UNIT_PREV, na.rm = TRUE),
      EZ_SeasonPrevalence = mean(SeasonPresence_EZ >= MIN_UNIT_PREV, na.rm = TRUE),
      OverallLog2Ratio = summary_value(SeasonLog2Ratio),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  overall_by_park <- park_effects %>%
    group_by(TaxonID) %>%
    summarise(
      OverallLog2Ratio_ParkPath = summary_value(ParkLog2Ratio),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  overall_desc <- coverage_summary %>%
    left_join(overall_by_season, by = "TaxonID") %>%
    left_join(overall_by_park, by = "TaxonID") %>%
    mutate(
      SummaryMethod = SUMMARY_METHOD,
      OverallDirection = sign_class(OverallLog2Ratio),
      OverallDirection_ParkPath = sign_class(OverallLog2Ratio_ParkPath),
      OverallSeasonParkPathDirectionAgreement =
        OverallDirection == OverallDirection_ParkPath,
      Full12ParkSeasonCoverage =
        NParkSeasonAvailable == length(SEASON_LEVELS) * length(EXPECTED_PARKS),
      AllAvailableParkSeasonSameDirection = case_when(
        NParkSeasonAvailable > 0 & NParkSeasonUp == NParkSeasonAvailable ~ TRUE,
        NParkSeasonAvailable > 0 & NParkSeasonDown == NParkSeasonAvailable ~ TRUE,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      ),
      ParkSeasonDirection = case_when(
        NParkSeasonAvailable > 0 & NParkSeasonUp == NParkSeasonAvailable ~ "Up",
        NParkSeasonAvailable > 0 & NParkSeasonDown == NParkSeasonAvailable ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "Mixed"
      ),
      All12ParkSeasonSameDirection =
        Full12ParkSeasonCoverage & AllAvailableParkSeasonSameDirection,
      BZ_HighState = OverallAbundance_BZ >= HIGH_ABUND &
        BZ_SeasonPrevalence >= MIN_UNIT_PREV,
      EZ_HighState = OverallAbundance_EZ >= HIGH_ABUND &
        EZ_SeasonPrevalence >= MIN_UNIT_PREV
    )

  season_summary <- season_effects %>%
    group_by(TaxonID) %>%
    summarise(
      NSeasonsAvailable = n_distinct(Season),
      NSeasonsUp = sum(SeasonSign == "Up", na.rm = TRUE),
      NSeasonsDown = sum(SeasonSign == "Down", na.rm = TRUE),
      NSeasonStrongUp = sum(SeasonStrongClass == "Up_2fold_or_more", na.rm = TRUE),
      NSeasonStrongDown = sum(SeasonStrongClass == "Down_2fold_or_more", na.rm = TRUE),
      StrongUpSeasons = paste(as.character(Season[SeasonStrongClass == "Up_2fold_or_more"]),
                              collapse = ";"),
      StrongDownSeasons = paste(as.character(Season[SeasonStrongClass == "Down_2fold_or_more"]),
                                collapse = ";"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      FourSeasonSameDirection =
        NSeasonsAvailable == length(SEASON_LEVELS) &
        (NSeasonsUp == length(SEASON_LEVELS) |
           NSeasonsDown == length(SEASON_LEVELS)),
      SeasonDirection = case_when(
        NSeasonsAvailable == length(SEASON_LEVELS) &
          NSeasonsUp == length(SEASON_LEVELS) ~ "Up",
        NSeasonsAvailable == length(SEASON_LEVELS) &
          NSeasonsDown == length(SEASON_LEVELS) ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "Mixed"
      ),
      FourSeasonAllAtLeast2Fold =
        FourSeasonSameDirection &
        ((SeasonDirection == "Up" & NSeasonStrongUp == length(SEASON_LEVELS)) |
           (SeasonDirection == "Down" & NSeasonStrongDown == length(SEASON_LEVELS)))
    )

  park_summary <- park_effects %>%
    group_by(TaxonID) %>%
    summarise(
      NParksAvailable = n_distinct(Park),
      NParksUp = sum(ParkSign == "Up", na.rm = TRUE),
      NParksDown = sum(ParkSign == "Down", na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ThreeParkSameDirection =
        NParksAvailable == length(EXPECTED_PARKS) &
        (NParksUp == length(EXPECTED_PARKS) |
           NParksDown == length(EXPECTED_PARKS)),
      ParkDirection = case_when(
        NParksAvailable == length(EXPECTED_PARKS) &
          NParksUp == length(EXPECTED_PARKS) ~ "Up",
        NParksAvailable == length(EXPECTED_PARKS) &
          NParksDown == length(EXPECTED_PARKS) ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "Mixed"
      )
    )

  park_season_matrix <- park_season_effects %>%
    mutate(
      Season = as.character(Season),
      Park = as.character(Park),
      ParkSeason = paste(Season, Park, sep = "_")
    ) %>%
    select(TaxonID, ParkSeason, ParkSeasonLog2Ratio,
           ParkSeasonNContexts, ParkSeasonNCycles) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = ParkSeason,
      values_from = c(ParkSeasonLog2Ratio, ParkSeasonNContexts, ParkSeasonNCycles),
      names_glue = "{.value}_{ParkSeason}"
    )

  season_matrix <- season_effects %>%
    mutate(Season = as.character(Season)) %>%
    select(TaxonID, Season, SeasonLog2Ratio) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Season, values_from = SeasonLog2Ratio,
                names_prefix = "SeasonLog2_")

  park_matrix <- park_effects %>%
    mutate(Park = as.character(Park)) %>%
    select(TaxonID, Park, ParkLog2Ratio) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Park, values_from = ParkLog2Ratio,
                names_prefix = "ParkLog2_")

  list(
    context_effects = context_effects,
    park_season_effects = park_season_effects,
    season_effects = season_effects,
    park_effects = park_effects,
    overall_desc = overall_desc,
    season_summary = season_summary,
    park_summary = park_summary,
    park_season_matrix = park_season_matrix,
    season_matrix = season_matrix,
    park_matrix = park_matrix
  )
}
```

## 11. DeltaCLR heterogeneity: median-based context summaries

```{r delta-clr-heterogeneity}
build_heterogeneity <- function() {
  context_clr <- build_context_clr(
    count_mat = otu_mat,
    meta_df = analysis_meta,
    taxa_ids = BZ_EZ_TAXA,
    sample_ids = analysis_meta$SampleID
  )

  delta_clr <- context_clr %>%
    mutate(Stage = as.character(Stage)) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(BrewingCycle, Season, Park, BrewingGroupID, TaxonID),
      names_from = Stage,
      values_from = c(CLR, NBioRep),
      names_glue = "{.value}_{Stage}"
    ) %>%
    filter(NBioRep_BZ == EXPECTED_N_BIOREP,
           NBioRep_EZ == EXPECTED_N_BIOREP) %>%
    mutate(
      DeltaCLR = CLR_EZ - CLR_BZ,
      BrewingCycle = factor(as.character(BrewingCycle), levels = CORE_CYCLES),
      Season = factor(as.character(Season), levels = SEASON_LEVELS),
      Park = factor(as.character(Park), levels = EXPECTED_PARKS)
    )

  season_heterogeneity <- delta_clr %>%
    group_by(TaxonID) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      p <- factor_block_p_available(
        .x, response = "DeltaCLR", target_factor = "Season",
        covariates = c("Park", "BrewingCycle")
      )
      tibble(SeasonHeterogeneityP = p)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      SeasonHeterogeneityQ = p.adjust(SeasonHeterogeneityP, method = "BH"),
      SeasonHeterogeneityTestable = !is.na(SeasonHeterogeneityQ),
      SeasonHeterogeneityDetected = SeasonHeterogeneityTestable &
        SeasonHeterogeneityQ < FDR_CUTOFF
    )

  park_heterogeneity <- delta_clr %>%
    group_by(TaxonID) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      p <- factor_block_p_available(
        .x, response = "DeltaCLR", target_factor = "Park",
        covariates = c("Season", "BrewingCycle")
      )
      tibble(ParkHeterogeneityP = p)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      ParkHeterogeneityQ = p.adjust(ParkHeterogeneityP, method = "BH"),
      ParkHeterogeneityTestable = !is.na(ParkHeterogeneityQ),
      ParkHeterogeneityDetected = ParkHeterogeneityTestable &
        ParkHeterogeneityQ < FDR_CUTOFF
    )

  list(
    delta_clr = delta_clr,
    season = season_heterogeneity,
    park = park_heterogeneity
  )
}
```

## 13. Integrate median descriptive results with the SAME ANCOM-BC2 result

```{r integrate-results}
integrate_results <- function(desc, hetero) {
  integrated <- desc$overall_desc %>%
    left_join(ancom_global, by = "TaxonID") %>%
    left_join(desc$season_summary, by = c("TaxonID", "NSeasonsAvailable")) %>%
    left_join(desc$park_summary, by = c("TaxonID", "NParksAvailable")) %>%
    left_join(desc$season_matrix, by = "TaxonID") %>%
    left_join(desc$park_matrix, by = "TaxonID") %>%
    left_join(hetero$season, by = "TaxonID") %>%
    left_join(hetero$park, by = "TaxonID") %>%
    mutate(
      ANCOMDirectionMatchesOverall =
        ANCOMDirection %in% c("Up", "Down") &
        OverallDirection == ANCOMDirection,

      ParkSeasonDirectionMatchesOverall =
        AllAvailableParkSeasonSameDirection &
        ParkSeasonDirection == OverallDirection,

      SeasonDirectionMatchesOverall =
        FourSeasonSameDirection &
        SeasonDirection == OverallDirection,

      ParkDirectionMatchesOverall =
        ThreeParkSameDirection &
        ParkDirection == OverallDirection,

      ## This is the only descriptive + inferential Stage-response gate.
      ## Nonrobust ANCOM results can never satisfy GlobalResponseRobust.
      GlobalResponseRobust =
        ANCOM_RobustSupported %in% TRUE &
        ANCOMDirectionMatchesOverall %in% TRUE &
        abs(OverallLog2Ratio) >= LFC_RESPONSE,

      GlobalResponseRobustClass = case_when(
        GlobalResponseRobust & OverallDirection == "Up" ~ "EZ_enriched",
        GlobalResponseRobust & OverallDirection == "Down" ~ "EZ_depleted",
        TRUE ~ "No_robust_stage_response"
      ),

      PersistentCandidate =
        RUN_ANCOMBC2 & is.finite(ANCOM_Q) &
        !(ANCOM_RobustSupported %in% TRUE) &
        !(ANCOM_Diff %in% TRUE) &
        BZ_HighState & EZ_HighState &
        abs(OverallLog2Ratio) <= LFC_PERSISTENT_MAX,

      ParkConsistencyLevel = case_when(
        All12ParkSeasonSameDirection &
          ParkHeterogeneityTestable &
          !ParkHeterogeneityDetected ~
          "12cell_direction_consistent_no_detected_park_heterogeneity",

        All12ParkSeasonSameDirection &
          ParkHeterogeneityDetected ~
          "12cell_direction_consistent_but_park_magnitude_heterogeneous",

        All12ParkSeasonSameDirection &
          !ParkHeterogeneityTestable ~
          "12cell_direction_consistent_park_heterogeneity_not_testable",

        !Full12ParkSeasonCoverage & AllAvailableParkSeasonSameDirection ~
          "available_cells_direction_consistent_but_incomplete_12cell_coverage",

        TRUE ~ "mixed_ParkSeason_direction"
      ),

      FinalEvidenceLevel = case_when(
        GlobalResponseRobust &
          Full12ParkSeasonCoverage &
          All12ParkSeasonSameDirection &
          ParkSeasonDirectionMatchesOverall &
          FourSeasonAllAtLeast2Fold &
          SeasonDirectionMatchesOverall ~
          "Core_4season_2fold_3park",

        GlobalResponseRobust &
          Full12ParkSeasonCoverage &
          All12ParkSeasonSameDirection &
          ParkSeasonDirectionMatchesOverall &
          FourSeasonSameDirection &
          SeasonDirectionMatchesOverall ~
          "Core_4season_direction_3park",

        GlobalResponseRobust &
          !Full12ParkSeasonCoverage &
          AllAvailableParkSeasonSameDirection &
          ParkSeasonDirectionMatchesOverall ~
          "Robust_recurrent_incomplete_12cell_coverage",

        GlobalResponseRobust ~
          "Global_robust_stage_response",

        ANCOM_RobustSupported %in% TRUE ~
          "ANCOMBC2_robust_below_2fold_or_direction_mismatch",

        ANCOM_FDRNonrobust %in% TRUE ~
          "FDR_supported_nonrobust",

        PersistentCandidate ~
          "Persistent_candidate",

        TRUE ~ "Exploratory"
      )
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      retained_summary %>%
        select(TaxonID, NStageSeasonGroupsObserved, NStageSeasonGroupsPassing,
               MaxStageSeasonPrevalence, RetainedByStageSeasonUnion),
      by = "TaxonID"
    )

  if (!is.null(tax)) integrated <- integrated %>% left_join(tax, by = "TaxonID")

  integrated %>%
    arrange(
      factor(
        FinalEvidenceLevel,
        levels = c(
          "Core_4season_2fold_3park",
          "Core_4season_direction_3park",
          "Robust_recurrent_incomplete_12cell_coverage",
          "Global_robust_stage_response",
          "ANCOMBC2_robust_below_2fold_or_direction_mismatch",
          "FDR_supported_nonrobust",
          "Persistent_candidate",
          "Exploratory"
        )
      ),
      desc(abs(OverallLog2Ratio))
    )
}
```

## 14. Stage-specific core ASVs: auxiliary median-only output

```{r stage-core}
build_stage_core <- function() {
  stage_context_complete <- meta %>%
    mutate(Stage = factor(as.character(Stage), levels = ANALYSIS_TYPES)) %>%
    count(BrewingCycle, Season, Park, Stage, name = "NBioRep") %>%
    filter(NBioRep == EXPECTED_N_BIOREP) %>%
    select(BrewingCycle, Season, Park, Stage)

  core_sample_ids <- meta %>%
    semi_join(stage_context_complete,
              by = c("BrewingCycle", "Season", "Park", "Stage")) %>%
    pull(SampleID) %>% as.character()

  core_rel_long <- as.data.frame(
    t(otu_rel_all[BZ_EZ_TAXA, core_sample_ids, drop = FALSE]),
    check.names = FALSE
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>% as_tibble() %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -SampleID, names_to = "TaxonID", values_to = "RelAbund") %>%
    left_join(meta, by = "SampleID") %>%
    mutate(Present = RelAbund > 0) %>%
    group_by(BrewingCycle, Season, Park, Stage, TaxonID) %>%
    summarise(
      ContextAbundance = summary_value(RelAbund),
      ReplicatePrevalence = mean(Present, na.rm = TRUE),
      NBioRep = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    inner_join(stage_context_complete,
               by = c("BrewingCycle", "Season", "Park", "Stage")) %>%
    mutate(ContextPresent = ReplicatePrevalence >= MIN_REP_PREV)

  core_stage_long <- core_rel_long %>%
    group_by(Stage, TaxonID) %>%
    summarise(
      NEligibleContexts = n(),
      NPresentContexts = sum(ContextPresent, na.rm = TRUE),
      ContextPrevalence = mean(ContextPresent, na.rm = TRUE),
      NParksPresent = n_distinct(Park[ContextPresent]),
      NSeasonsPresent = n_distinct(Season[ContextPresent]),
      OverallContextAbundance = summary_value(ContextAbundance),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      AllParksAndSeasonsRepresented =
        NParksPresent == length(EXPECTED_PARKS) &
        NSeasonsPresent == length(SEASON_LEVELS),
      StrictObservedCore =
        NPresentContexts == NEligibleContexts & AllParksAndSeasonsRepresented,
      RobustCore90 =
        ContextPrevalence >= 0.90 & AllParksAndSeasonsRepresented
    )

  core_stage_wide <- core_stage_long %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = TaxonID,
      names_from = Stage,
      values_from = c(NEligibleContexts, NPresentContexts, ContextPrevalence,
                      NParksPresent, NSeasonsPresent, AllParksAndSeasonsRepresented,
                      OverallContextAbundance, StrictObservedCore, RobustCore90),
      names_glue = "{Stage}_{.value}"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      SummaryMethod = SUMMARY_METHOD,
      BZ_StrictObservedCore = replace_na(BZ_StrictObservedCore, FALSE),
      EZ_StrictObservedCore = replace_na(EZ_StrictObservedCore, FALSE),
      BZ_RobustCore90 = replace_na(BZ_RobustCore90, FALSE),
      EZ_RobustCore90 = replace_na(EZ_RobustCore90, FALSE),
      StrictCorePattern = case_when(
        BZ_StrictObservedCore & EZ_StrictObservedCore ~ "Shared_BZ_EZ_core",
        BZ_StrictObservedCore & !EZ_StrictObservedCore ~ "BZ_core_only",
        !BZ_StrictObservedCore & EZ_StrictObservedCore ~ "EZ_core_only",
        TRUE ~ "Not_strict_core"
      ),
      RobustCore90Pattern = case_when(
        BZ_RobustCore90 & EZ_RobustCore90 ~ "Shared_BZ_EZ_core90",
        BZ_RobustCore90 & !EZ_RobustCore90 ~ "BZ_core90_only",
        !BZ_RobustCore90 & EZ_RobustCore90 ~ "EZ_core90_only",
        TRUE ~ "Not_core90"
      )
    )

  if (!is.null(tax)) core_stage_wide <- core_stage_wide %>% left_join(tax, by = "TaxonID")
  core_stage_wide
}
```

## 15. Run the median descriptive pipeline and write outputs

```{r run-analysis}
message("Running descriptive pipeline: median")

desc <- build_descriptive_pipeline()
hetero <- build_heterogeneity()
integrated <- integrate_results(desc, hetero)
stage_core <- build_stage_core()

## Full trace of Cycle-context effects.
write.csv(
  desc$context_effects,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "02a_BZ_EZ_Cycle_context_effects_median.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## Critical 4 seasons × 3 parks layer; each cell may have one or two cycles.
write.csv(
  desc$park_season_effects,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "02b_BZ_EZ_ParkSeason_effects_median.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## Season and Park marginal summaries are diagnostic, not substitutes for
## the strict 12-cell Park × Season consistency rule.
write.csv(
  desc$season_effects,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "02c_BZ_EZ_Season_effects_median.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  desc$park_effects,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "02d_BZ_EZ_Park_effects_median.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## Wide recurrence diagnostics: 12 Park×Season cells + four seasons + three parks.
recurrence_diagnostics <- desc$overall_desc %>%
  left_join(desc$season_summary, by = c("TaxonID", "NSeasonsAvailable")) %>%
  left_join(desc$park_summary, by = c("TaxonID", "NParksAvailable")) %>%
  left_join(desc$park_season_matrix, by = "TaxonID") %>%
  left_join(desc$season_matrix, by = "TaxonID") %>%
  left_join(desc$park_matrix, by = "TaxonID")

if (!is.null(tax)) recurrence_diagnostics <- recurrence_diagnostics %>% left_join(tax, by = "TaxonID")

write.csv(
  recurrence_diagnostics,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "04_BZ_EZ_recurrence_diagnostics_median.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## DeltaCLR magnitude-heterogeneity diagnostics.
heterogeneity_output <- hetero$season %>%
  left_join(hetero$park, by = "TaxonID")
if (!is.null(tax)) heterogeneity_output <- heterogeneity_output %>% left_join(tax, by = "TaxonID")

write.csv(
  heterogeneity_output,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "04b_BZ_EZ_heterogeneity_median.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## Main one-row-per-ASV result.
write.csv(
  integrated,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "05_final_BZ_EZ_stage_selection_median.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## Auxiliary BZ/EZ stage-core membership result.
write.csv(
  stage_core,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "06_BZ_EZ_stage_core_ASV_median.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## 16. Compact QC summary + parameter manifest

```{r qc-manifest-session}
ancombc_version <- if (RUN_ANCOMBC2) as.character(utils::packageVersion("ANCOMBC")) else "not_run"

qc_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "N_BZ_EZ_samples_after_basic_QC",
    "N_ASVs_after_basic_QC_before_prevalence_filter",
    "N_ASVs_retained_by_StageSeason_union",
    "N_complete_matched_Cycle_contexts_for_BZ_EZ",
    "N_observed_ParkSeason_cells",
    "N_ParkSeason_cells_with_two_cycles",
    "N_ParkSeason_cells_with_one_cycle",
    "N_missing_ParkSeason_cells"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(meta),
    nrow(otu_mat),
    length(BZ_EZ_TAXA),
    length(eligible_groups),
    sum(park_season_coverage$ParkSeasonObserved),
    sum(park_season_coverage$NEligibleCycles >= 2),
    sum(park_season_coverage$NEligibleCycles == 1),
    sum(!park_season_coverage$ParkSeasonObserved)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write.csv(qc_summary,
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "00_QC_analysis_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

parameter_manifest <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c(
    "DATASET_LABEL",
    "ANALYSIS_TYPES",
    "CORE_CYCLES",
    "SEASON_LEVELS",
    "EXPECTED_PARKS",
    "EXPECTED_N_BIOREP",
    "PREVALENCE_CUT_PRIMARY",
    "Prevalence_filter_rule",
    "Filtering_before_context_selection",
    "Relative_abundance_denominator",
    "RATIO_PSEUDOCOUNT",
    "RATIO_PSEUDOCOUNT_role",
    "RESPONSE_FOLD_CUTOFF",
    "PERSISTENT_MAX_FOLD_CHANGE",
    "SUMMARY_METHOD",
    "Descriptive_hierarchy",
    "Missing_cycle_handling",
    "Strict_crosspark_fourseason_rule",
    "ANCOMBC_version",
    "ANCOM_model",
    "ANCOM_p_adjust_method",
    "ANCOM_pseudo_sens",
    "ANCOM_core_statistical_rule",
    "Nonrobust_rule",
    "Heterogeneity_column_names",
    "Heterogeneity_interpretation"
  ),
  Value = c(
    DATASET_LABEL,
    paste(ANALYSIS_TYPES, collapse = ";"),
    paste(CORE_CYCLES, collapse = ";"),
    paste(SEASON_LEVELS, collapse = ";"),
    paste(EXPECTED_PARKS, collapse = ";"),
    EXPECTED_N_BIOREP,
    PREVALENCE_CUT_PRIMARY,
    "Retain ASV if prevalence >=10% in at least one Stage × Season group; one common BZ–EZ union feature space",
    "TRUE: filter ASVs first, then select complete matched BZ–EZ contexts for the BZ–EZ comparison",
    "Raw taxon count / total raw counts of all valid BZ/EZ taxa after basic QC and before prevalence filtering",
    RATIO_PSEUDOCOUNT,
    "Descriptive zero handling only; never used as a statistical-robustness or Core-selection criterion",
    RESPONSE_FOLD_CUTOFF,
    PERSISTENT_MAX_FOLD_CHANGE,
    SUMMARY_METHOD,
    "biological replicates -> Cycle context -> Park×Season across available cycles -> Season/Park -> Overall; primary Overall uses the Season path and Park-path Overall is reported diagnostically",
    "A Park×Season cell can use one or two eligible cycles; an absent cycle does not invalidate the cell if another eligible cycle exists",
    "Strict Core recurrence requires all 12 Park×Season cells observed and all 12 same sign; it does not require every cycle to contain all 12 cells",
    ancombc_version,
    "Individual-sample raw counts; fix_formula = BrewingGroupID + Stage; BrewingGroupID = BrewingCycle×Season×Park",
    ANCOM_P_ADJ_METHOD,
    ANCOM_PSEUDO_SENS,
    "Core statistical gate = unambiguous Structural_zero_supported OR ANCOM_DiffRobust=TRUE; plus descriptive effect-size/direction requirements",
    "ANCOM_Diff=TRUE but ANCOM_DiffRobust!=TRUE is reported as FDR_supported_nonrobust and cannot enter any Core class",
    "SeasonHeterogeneityP/Q and ParkHeterogeneityP/Q",
    "Auxiliary magnitude tests on DeltaCLR; significant heterogeneity does not automatically remove a direction-consistent taxon"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
```
